困难原因必须为可选原因列表: Reasons must be a list of optional reason codes.
困难原因包含未知或重复选项: Reasons contain an unknown or duplicate option.
请选择 2 · 斑块组成；不能确定时可选“类型不确定”: Select 2 · Plaque composition; choose Uncertain type if needed.
正常或不可评估不应保留斑块组成: Normal and non-evaluable findings cannot retain plaque composition.
明确正常对应无斑块、狭窄 0%；非斑块性狭窄不能标为明确正常: Normal means no plaque and 0% stenosis. Non-plaque stenosis cannot be labeled normal.
旧版备注必须为文字: The legacy note must be text.
不可评估应跳过狭窄分级与把握，保存为无法判断和不适用: Not evaluable skips stenosis grading and confidence; these are saved as unable and not applicable.
请选择 4 · 判断把握；更改诊断后需重新确认把握: Select 4 · Confidence; confirm it again after changing the finding.
只有明确的非零狭窄等级可指定最狭窄位置: Peak stenosis requires an explicit nonzero stenosis grade.
最狭窄位置必须为有效非负毫米值: Peak stenosis must be a valid nonnegative distance in millimeters.
只有不可评估时可选择困难原因: Reasons can be selected only for a non-evaluable interval.
此字段不适用于当前所见，请先选择本段所见: This field does not apply to the current finding. Select a finding first.
